calls.statement:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS web_orders
FROM fact_web_order o
WHERE CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) = DATE '2025-12-01'
  AND o.status <> 'cancelled'

SELECT CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS order_date,
       COUNT(*) AS web_orders
FROM fact_web_order o
WHERE CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) = DATE '2025-12-01'
  AND o.status <> 'cancelled'
GROUP BY 1
